name: portfolio-platform
description: Portfolio/CV platform for Abel Valle Rosa with independent Next.js frontend and NestJS REST API.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix apps/api run test:e2e && npm --prefix apps/web run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
